  "chunks": [

      "chunk_type": "opening",
      "arabic_text": "يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ', 'translations': { 'en': 'O you who believe, do not follow in the footsteps of Satan,' } }, { 'chunk_type': 'body', 'arabic_text': 'وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ', 'translations': { 'en': 'for he who follows in the footsteps of Satan will be induced by him to what is shameful and forbidden.' } }, { 'chunk_type': 'body', 'arabic_text': 'وَلَوْ لَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ مَا زَكَٰ مِنكُمْ مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًا', 'translations': { 'en': 'But for the grace of God and His mercy upon you none of you would have escaped undefiled;' } }, { 'chunk_type': 'body', 'arabic_text': 'وَلٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يُزَكِّي مَن يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ', 'translations': { 'en': 'but God makes whosoever He will grow in goodness, for God is all-hearing and all-knowing.' } } ], "
